title: Health Related Quality of Life of Patients With Abdominal Wall Defects
brief_summary: Examination of the health-related quality of life of patients operated on due to congenital defects of the abdominal wall after birth with the questionnaires KINDL, SDQ and SF-36.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Congenital abdominal wall defect
* Surgically corrected in our department
* Survivor

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not surgically corrected in our department
* Non-Survivor
study_population: Patients with congenital abdominal wall defect, e.g. gastroschisis or omphalocele
